headlines.title: Two trapped workers pulled alive from Nepal tunnel more than a week after deadly floods
headlines.description: Two workers in Nepal were pulled out alive from a hydropower tunnel on Friday, some nine days after devastating floods swept the Himalayan region and left thousands of people missing.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jury risks mistrial on 7th day of deliberations after 2 deadlock notes
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s defense team filed a motion to Judge William Sullivan on Friday asking that there be no more sidebars for the remainder of the triple-murder trial, and that all further proceedings be handled in open court.

headlines.title: Missouri Supreme Court rules new GOP-drawn map can’t be used in November
headlines.description: The court said a referendum seeking to put the map up for a vote must be placed on the ballot, meaning the state’s elections this fall will take place under its old congressional lines.

headlines.title: The unspoken testimony in the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Dozens of witnesses were called over three weeks in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy to testify about what led up to and followed the killing of her three young children. But one person who didn’t take the stand was Clancy herself. Both the prosecution and defense, however, read extensively from Clancy’s diary entries from the months leading up to the killings in a coastal Massachusetts town in 2023. headlines.title: What the jury must consider while deciding Lindsay Clancy's fate
headlines.description: As the jury considers the arguments presented by the prosecution and defense in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial, NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris and correspondent Steven Romo break down the instructions the 9 women and 3 men were given before heading into deliberations.

headlines.title: What is the Tuey-Rodriguez instruction the judge gave in the Lindsey Clancy trial?
headlines.description: Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial told the judge on Wednesday they were deadlocked for a second time, a day after they issued a first deadlock note to the judge. NBC News’ Laura Jarrett and Misty Marris explain the significance of the Tuey-Rodriguez instruction the judge gave the jury and why this next round of deliberation is crucial to the trial.

headlines.title: A first of its kind organ transplant technique tried on a human subject
headlines.description: Meet the first-ever patient to receive stem cells from their donor, in the hope of avoiding toxic anti-rejection drugs. NBC News' Camila Bernal spoke to the patient who received a liver transplant from her sister.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Senior aides to British Trump ally Nigel Farage step down after foreign funding sting
headlines.description: Britain’s populist Reform UK said two senior aides to leader Nigel Farage stepped down on Friday after an undercover investigation alleged the party had broken electoral law by arranging for a foreign donor to pay for political polling.
